answer: Each challenge commits to a task seed that is revealed only by hashing its request with a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse. Until the drand quorum publishes that unpredictable, publicly verifiable value, an agent cannot precompute solutions or farm identities offline. Verification binds each response to the commitment, beacon round, and agent identity, while admission costs and rate limits make mass Sybil creation uneconomical. Consequently, opal, dawn, and trellis tasks remain fresh and unbiasable.
